title: Completeness of the quadratic PCPP system
statement: Let $n$ be positive, let $L$ be a finite list of homogeneous quadratic equations over $\mathbb F_2$ in $n$ variables, and let $w\in\{0,1\}^n$ satisfy every equation in $L$. There is an encoded proof of length $2^n+2^{n^2}$, formed from the linear and rank-one quadratic characters determined by the binary encoding of $w$, for which the associated quadratic PCPP verifier accepts with probability exactly $1$.
hypotheses_covered: a finite list $L$ of homogeneous quadratic equations
